subject: Mutual Action Plan: security package delivery & SOC 2 checklist
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@harborbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: security package delivery & SOC 2 checklist

Hi Laura — great to meet earlier. Per our call I put together a concise MAP slice focused on the security review / SOC 2 deliverables so Harbor Bank can complete internal approval ahead of the procurement window. Attaching a draft MAP (Redwood_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and a populated SOC 2 questionnaire stub for your review.

Key milestones in this draft: 
- 2027-12-08: Security questionnaire returned (Harbor security) — owner: Harbor (Laura/Tom)
- 2027-12-15: Evidence upload to shared folder (Harbor) — owner: Harbor (security@harborbank.com)
- 2027-12-20: Redwood evidence packet (SOC 2-ready) delivered — owner: Redwood (Rishi)
- 2027-12-22: Joint evidence review / Q&A call — owner: joint (Vanessa / Harbor security)
- 2027-12-29: Procurement sign-off target (commercial/ops) — owner: Harbor procurement

Dependencies and notes: 
- Harbor to provide list of required evidence artifacts using the attached evidence-matrix-template.csv so we can pre-validate format.
- If any items are vendor-only (e.g., HSM receipts), note in the matrix so Redwood can route to our compliance team.
- We can compress timelines by one week if Harbor confirms the questionnaire by 12/05 and provides SSO test account details.

Next steps I propose: Harbor completes questionnaire (SOC2_Questionnaire_HarborBank.docx) and returns by 12/08; Redwood (Rishi) will assemble the Redwood packet and drop files into the shared Drive link when ready. Can you confirm the owners and the 12/08 target?

Thanks — I left an easy checklist in the MAP for the security reviewer.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_Questionnaire_HarborBank.docx (doc), evidence-matrix-template.csv (csv)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@harborbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@harborbank.com>, security@harborbank.com
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: security package delivery & SOC 2 checklist

Vanessa — thanks for the recap and the clear MAP. Quick answers from our side: 
- Confirming owners: Laura (security lead) / Tom (infra ops) will own returning the questionnaire and uploading evidence.
- 12/08 for the questionnaire is tight but achievable if we get the matrix and sample artifacts early this week. We'll aim for 12/07 to give procurement time.

Questions / clarifications: 
1) For "evidence upload to shared folder" — can Redwood provide a naming convention and a single target folder? We prefer one place vs scattered links.
2) For items that Redwood marks as "operational control evidence", do you expect redaction or will Redwood provide sanitized copies?

Tom and I will review the SOC2_Questionnaire_HarborBank.docx and respond with edits by 12/06. If anything comes up we'll flag in the evidence-matrix-template.csv.

Appreciate you and the team moving quickly here.

— Laura Chen
Security Lead, Harbor Bank
laura.chen@harborbank.com | +1 617-555-0201
Attachment: (none)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@harborbank.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: security package delivery & SOC 2 checklist

Thanks Laura — quick reply from the Redwood compliance side: 
- We will create a single Drive folder with the naming convention: HarborBank_HB-2027-1493_SOC2/<artifact-type>_<owner>_<YYYYMMDD>. Example: access-control_redwood_20271220.pdf
- For operational control evidence we will provide sanitized copies where appropriate (e.g., redacted IP addresses) and mark redactions in the evidence-matrix-template.csv. If Harbor requires full internal logs we can discuss a temporary redacted share and an NDA addendum.

I'll start assembling our packet on 12/13 and aim to upload by 12/20 as discussed. Grace will take point on the internal evidence collection and will coordinate any follow-up questions with Tom.

Open items for Harbor to confirm: SSO test account (hostname, username) and the procurement contact for final sign-off. If you can share those by 12/06 we can keep to the current timeline.

— Rishi Malhotra
Principal, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: evidence-matrix-template.csv (filled sample will follow)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@harborbank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@harborbank.com>, security@harborbank.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: security package delivery & SOC 2 checklist

Rishi / Vanessa — thanks, that naming convention works for us. Confirming next items from Harbor: 
- We'll return the completed questionnaire by COB 2027-12-06 (Laura/Tom).
- Procurement contact is Maria Gutierrez (maria.gutierrez@harborbank.com). She asked for the final Redwood evidence package to land in Drive and for a short technical Q&A on 2027-12-22 (30 min).
- SSO test account: host auth.harborbank.test, user: soc2_test_user@harborbank.test (credentials to follow via secure transfer).

We'll upload the initial evidence set to the shared folder (HarborBank_HB-2027-1493_SOC2) and flag any items we can't produce. If Redwood needs an NDA addendum, please attach a template and we can fast-track.

Laura

On the Q&A call: please include an engineer who can discuss SSO and logging retention (Grace can lead from Redwood).

— Laura Chen
Security Lead, Harbor Bank
Attachment: evidence-matrix-template.csv (partial, noted missing items)

[Thread notes] Owner action items (internal):
- Vanessa: confirm Drive share + send DocuSign link for any NDA addendum (by 2027-12-01).
- Rishi: assemble Redwood packet, produce sanitized evidence, upload by 2027-12-20.
- Grace: prepare SSO / logging runbook and be on the 12/22 Q&A.
- Tessa: coordinate with Customer Success on procurement handoff and pricing appendix.

Attachments referenced above are stored in: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAPdoc
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HB-2027-1493
DocuSign (NDA addendum placeholder): https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning/12345
